# Auto-GEMS

[Auto-Global Examination of Mental State]{.sub}
:::

::: {.chips}
[<i class="bi bi-laptop"></i> Self-administered, web-based]{.chip}
[<i class="bi bi-clock"></i> About 10 minutes]{.chip}
[<i class="bi bi-list-check"></i> 11 tasks]{.chip}
[<i class="bi bi-files"></i> Parallel forms A and B]{.chip}
[<i class="bi bi-people"></i> 1,308 adults, 18–93 years]{.chip}
:::

::: {.prose}
Auto-GEMS is a web-based, self-administered version of GEMS. It runs in any current browser and is built on jsPsych and JATOS.
It can be used in three ways: a **ready-to-use online version**, a **local version** that runs offline on the clinician's computer, and a **remote data-collection** setup for research on your own JATOS server.
No sensitive data are stored on the server in the ready-to-use and local versions.

Its 11 tasks cover **orientation, immediate and delayed memory, months backwards, puzzle, spatial representation, naming, comprehension, Trail Making A and B** and **metaphor comprehension**.
A Shiny app compares the individual score with the normative data, taking age and cognitive reserve into account.
:::
